text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With <chrname>'s training wrapping up,
I had some free time on my hands.
Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And so! This Trainer-san here will be
our baseball manager! Clap clap♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accepting the role!
Though you look a bit bewildered, don't you? Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason I said "I think so" was because
I had just accepted moments ago
and hadn't been told any details yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just moments ago... merely a few minutes earlier—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There you are, Trainer-sa~n♡
Hey, so, like—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Be our baseball manager, pleeease~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: We're playing baseball on a TV show soon!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's a baseball project between celebrities and horse girls
to promote the racing world~.
Sponsored by the URA, or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So, I want you to be our manager!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because your pitching form is so clean, Trainer-san!
And we played catch together before—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna participate unless you're the manager!
Pleeease♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I had been pressured into it, but...
I should be able to manage it while still
securing time for <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are 8 members in total, excluding the pitcher.
The three Vivlos sisters, plus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion and Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, Daiwa Scarlet, and Sweep Tosho,
making 8 in total.
Quite a colorful bunch of personalities, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Is this really going to be alright?
choice_data_list: Since we're doing this, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of practice began.
Given the colorful cast, I braced myself
for plenty of trouble, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I really can't do it!
Me as the leadoff batter is just... um...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It has to be Cheval-chi, or no deal!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Your batting average is great, and you're good at stealing bases!
Seeing Cheval-chi on base makes me
feel so relieved when I'm at bat!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It has to be Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Your voice is too loud...! Um...
I get it, alright... geez...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'll go practice.
So I can... properly hit...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Manager!
Please stop this fight!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san's tantrum hit Scarlet-san like a blazing beanball,
and now she's raging in royal fury!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, wanna go~? To this sweets buffet!
The theme is 'Witches' Gathering', you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Witches' Gathering?! Let me see that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet-san, you come too, okay?
It's no fun unless we're together~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A-Alright, fine...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... The wind's totally out of my sails now.
Why was I even that mad in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Manager and everyone else, come with us too!
To the sweets buffet in this magazine♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? What happened to the massive slugfest about to erupt in three seconds...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, every time trouble seemed about to erupt,
Vivlos managed to resolve it.
choice_data_list: (Could she be acting like that on purpose—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go soon~! Can practice be over now?
No? Pleeease, why not~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...No, it doesn't seem intentional.
She's simply doing whatever she wants.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...?? What is it, Manager?
Why are you staring at me like that?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking the team's doing great thanks to you.
I was just thinking the team's doing great thanks to you.
I was just thinking how good you are at acting cute.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...?? What is it, Manager?
Why are you staring at me like that?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking the team's doing great thanks to you.
I was just thinking the team's doing great thanks to you.
I was just thinking how good you are at acting cute.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay, that makes me happy♡
Even though I haven't done anything♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Your actions have a positive effect on those around you.
Fufu, that is truly a wonderful thing, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? So I can just keep being myself?
Then as usual... I'll pamper myself a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's true, though... Even when you make unreasonable demands,
it doesn't really feel annoying.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay! In that case,
maybe I'll act even more spoiled♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Such childish whining
won't work on a great witch like me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Don't say that~!
Come on, let's get along, okay? Pleeease♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What's with this floating heart?!
Could this be...?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sweep? Why are you so surprised?
What heart~?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just now, was that...
Was that actual magic?!
